history.summary: Generic CSV name with several Khammam-city candidates. The best-supported referent is the Sri Abhayaanjaneya Swamy Devalayam on Hanuman Temple Road, Khammam city — the most prominent dedicated Hanuman temple in town (4.4 stars, 54 reviews, top-rated.online listing, consulted 2026-09-28), and Telugu press (Prajamantalu, April 2025) reported its annual brahmotsavas, confirming it is an active, organised temple. Other Hanuman/Anjaneya shrines also exist in and around Khammam — e.g., the Anjaneya Swamy temple at Bonakal and the Jalanjaneya Swamy Temple (Vallalavari Thota) in Khammam city — so the exact shrine the CSV intends cannot be confirmed; identity is flagged as provisional. No published founding history was found for the Abhaya Anjaneya temple (verify locally). CSV town (Khammam), district (Khammam) and state (Telangana) are all correct — no correction needed.

name: Sri Hanuman Temple (Abhaya Anjaneya, Khammam)
town_description: Khammam is a city and the district headquarters of Khammam district, Telangana, on the Munneru river, about 193 km east of Hyderabad. It is a major transport and trading hub of eastern Telangana, known for the Kakatiya-era Khammam Fort, the Stambadri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy temple on Narasimha Swami Gutta, and its mango and granite industries.
